      - strong: x = 5π/6
      - text: (150°) QII
    - article:
      - strong: x = 7π/6

    - paragraph: Filter the periodic roots to retain only values in [0, 2π).

    - paragraph: Coterminal solutions outside [0, 2π) are hidden.

      - heading "EXACT COORDINATES" [level=2]

          - row "x (cos x, sin x) cos x sin x":

            - columnheader "sin x"

          - row "5π/6 (150°) (-0.866, 0.500) -0.866 0.500":

            - cell "(-0.866, 0.500)"
            - cell "-0.866"
            - cell "0.500"
          - row "7π/6 (210°) (-0.866, -0.500) -0.866 -0.500":
